# IPBot Examples

Source: https://github.com/webunblocker/ipbot-examples/blob/main/README.md

# IPBot Examples

Code examples for integrating with the [IPBot API](https://ipbot.com) - a fast IP intelligence service with <10ms latency.

## Quick Start

```bash
curl -s https://api.ipbot.com/8.8.8.8 | jq
```

## Features

- **IP Geolocation** - Country, region, city, postal code, coordinates
- **ASN Lookup** - Network operator, organization, usage type
- **Risk Scoring** - Explainable risk assessment with reasons
- **Proxy Detection** - Datacenter, VPN, Tor exit identification
- **Threat Intelligence** - Real-time threat list matching

## Examples

| Language | File | Description |
|----------|------|-------------|
| Python | [python/ipbot_example.py](python/ipbot_example.py) | Basic lookup + error handling |
| JavaScript | [javascript/ipbot_example.js](javascript/ipbot_example.js) | Node.js + browser (fetch) |
| Go | [go/ipbot_example.go](go/ipbot_example.go) | Typed response structs |
| cURL | [curl/examples.sh](curl/examples.sh) | Shell one-liners |

## API Endpoints

| Endpoint | Description |
|----------|-------------|
| `GET /` | Auto-detect caller IP |
| `GET /{ip}` | Lookup specific IP |
| `GET /api?ip={ip}` | Query parameter style |
| `GET /health` | Service health check |

## Response Example

```json
{
  "ip": "8.8.8.8",
  "location": {
    "country": "United States",
    "country_code": "US",
    "region": "California",
    "city": "Mountain View",
    "latitude": 37.4056,
    "longitude": -122.0775
  },
  "network": {
    "asn": "AS15169",
    "org": "Google LLC",
    "radar": "isp"
  },
  "security": {
    "risk_score": 15,
    "risk_reasons": ["public_dns"],
    "is_datacenter": true,
    "is_proxy": false,
    "threat_level": "Low"
  }
}
```

## Documentation

Full API documentation: **[ipbot.com/docs](https://ipbot.com/docs)**

- [API Reference](https://ipbot.com/docs/api-reference) - Endpoints, parameters, error codes
- [Rate Limits](https://ipbot.com/docs/rate-limits) - Fair-use guidelines
- [Risk Scoring](https://ipbot.com/docs/ip-reputation-api) - How risk is calculated
